proposal:
STATUS. Hand-derived, unexecuted, unimplemented extension (FR-κ). It is not polynomial SAT and gives no universal growth bound: it parameterises one tractable family and proves where that family stops. The fixture probes v2 only. The watcher handoff has no bearing.

DIAGNOSIS. The 36/96 quotients are easy for one reason: an adapted basis turns every block of annihilator dimension d_K≤2 into a 2-clause. 'Incompatible greedy basis' is where that reason can fail structurally.

Lemma H (hand proof). Strictly compressible formulas with all d_K≤2 are NP-complete once the adapted basis is dropped. Reduce positive 1-in-3-SAT with v_i=x_i+x_i': each triple gives a 6-variable parity block (d=1), and each pair inside a triple gives a 4-variable block forbidding v_a=v_b=1 (d=2). Then r=n<2n. With an adapted basis the same class is 2-SAT. So compatibility is the tractability boundary here, not a cosmetic greedy detail.

MECHANISM FR-κ.
(1) Frame. Take the union of bases of all A_K: N forms of rank r with N−r parity relations. It always exists and needs no greedy choice.
(2) Collapse rank. κ' is the least dim U such that the distinct nonzero images of the frame forms modulo U are linearly independent. κ'=0 iff the distinct frame forms are independent, i.e. an adapted basis exists.
(3) Lemma B (hand proof). If all d_K≤2, fixing the 2^κ' values of a basis of U makes every frame form a literal or constant over r−κ' variables, so each branch is 2-SAT. Cost after discovery is 2^κ'·O(N+m').
(4) Lemma U (hand proof). An optimal U is spanned by vectors g_i and g_i+g_j, which gives N^O(k) discovery. Frame elements alone are not enough: {a,b,c,a+b+c} has κ'=1 via ⟨a+b⟩ but needs two of its own elements.
(5) Admission. Run only if a found U has k≤log2(L), L the literal count; otherwise skip unchanged. Any found U is sound; optimality affects coverage only.
(6) Certificate. A linear map E into frame coordinates, G∧Rel, and a lift R. Check F(x)=G(Ex) and Rel(Ex) on all 2^n points, and E(Rz)=z on the 2^r points satisfying Rel. This slightly generalises the Lean rule and is not yet proved in Lean.

WORK ACCOUNTING. Stabilisers lie inside S_K+s_0, so each block costs O(|S_K|^2·c) with no 2^c term. Rank costs O(N·n^2) bit operations. Admitted branching costs at most L·O(N+m'). Discovery at k=log L is the only term not shown polynomial (T91).

SCOPE AND FAILURE. Blocks with d_K≥3 skip. Added points become wide residue clauses, so FR does not repair the 36+9 control, which v2 already solves at peak 0 and 9. What survives extra clauses is discovery only: flats inside S_K are monotone under added clauses, stabilisers are not. In frame coordinates 00054's Lemma I is the pure-literal rule on fibre literals. A removed-point XOR block ('parity=c implies x=p') is lin-2 but costs up to c−1 in κ', so auto00009-type gadgets are probably not admitted.

FIXTURE (v2). Columns (1,2,3) and (4,5,6), with f=x_a+x_b, g=x_b+x_c, h=x_a+x_c. Blocks are f1∨f2, g1∨g2, ¬h1∨¬h2. Three pairwise-disjoint 2-dimensional spaces in rank 4 would need 6 basis vectors, so no adapted basis exists and the skip is structural. Hand DP trace: eliminating x1 leaves 4 non-tautological resolvents (12→8); after that every resolvent is a tautology (8→4→0, or 8→0). Predicted SAT, peak 0: a compression failure without a harder trace.

REPRODUCIBLE ADVERSARY (no peak prediction). Four columns (3j−2,3j−1,3j) with the same three blocks on each cyclic pair (j,j+1): 12 variables, 48 clauses, SAT by x=101 per column, r=8, κ'=4, and no adapted basis (12 basis vectors needed in rank 8). Hand claim: every root DP step replaces 16 clauses by 24 (48→56), so DP is STUCK at root. I cannot derive the search peak and do not predict it.

INDEPENDENT-TEST PREDICTIONS for FR. Fixture: N=6, r=4, k=2, four 2-variable branches. Cycle: k=4. auto00006/7: k=0 and the same quotient as v2; any difference is an FR bug. Open test, not a prediction: I have not seen auto00008. Brute-force all bases; an adapted basis means a greedy artefact (k=0), none means structural, and FR then reports k or the first block with d_K≥3.
missing_theorem: T91 (collapse-rank discovery). Input: N vectors spanning F_2^r and an integer k. Decide whether some subspace U of dimension at most k makes the distinct nonzero images modulo U linearly independent, and return U. Prove either an algorithm running in 2^O(k)·poly(N,r), or NP-hardness together with a polynomial constant-factor approximation. Without it, admission at k≤log L has quasi-polynomial discovery N^O(log N), and the family is not shown polynomial in total work. Known by hand only: N^O(k) via Lemma U; k=0 is a rank test; independent M3 triples each force one dimension. Prerequisites still unproved in Lean for general n: Lemma B, Lemma U, Lemma H and the relation-certificate rule. T89 and T90 remain open.
self_attack:
1. This is still family detection. κ' can be Θ(r), and Lemma H shows the class is NP-complete, so FR cannot become universal.
2. The fixture predicts peak 0 on v2, so FR shows no measured advantage there. Its advantage rests on the cycle, which is unmeasured; if v2's search solves it at peak 1 or 2, FR is redundant engineering.
3. Extra-clause robustness is not delivered. Monotone flats protect discovery, not tractability. The 36+9 control stays outside, exactly as in 00054.
4. I have not seen auto00008. Its skip may be a greedy artefact, or it may contain d_K≥3 blocks, in which case FR says nothing about peak 16.
5. Branching on 2^k values is brute force when k is near r. Under 12 variables the log L admission is indistinguishable from a fixed cap of about 6, which the brief warns against.
6. Rel-restricted lifting is not covered by CompressionSoundness.lean.
7. The DP traces are hand simulations. I assumed the ordering, the IALH windows (three 4-variable windows, no hull rows) and the meaning of peak. The 48→56 claim ignores any Canon effect I did not foresee.
8. Lemmas B, H and U are hand proofs. An error in U would break the discovery bound but not soundness.

delta_from_prior:
00054 (FFQ) treated extra points through residue mass Φ and left incompatibility as a lattice remark.

New here:
(1) Lemma H: without an adapted basis the binary-block compressible class is NP-complete, so incompatibility is a real boundary.
(2) The invariant κ', with Lemma B (2^κ' 2-SAT branches) and Lemma U (N^O(k) discovery, with frame-only branching shown suboptimal).
(3) A size-relative admission rule and explicit total-work terms, with stabilisers computed without a 2^c factor.
(4) An exact pointwise certificate with relations, replacing 00054's equisatisfiability-only retraction for this family.
(5) Lemma I re-read as a pure-literal rule in frame coordinates.
(6) A minimal structurally incompatible fixture and a 48-clause cycle adversary with a hand-derived root-STUCK claim.

Not new: no progress on Φ≥1, T89 or T90.
